role: XCUITest that the app survives a background/foreground round trip, framed as widget integration coverage.

flags.text: Passes the bare '-UITests' launch argument, which no production code reads (only -UITests-FreshInstall at AppLaunchRecovery.swift:185 and -UITests-ForcePaywall/-UITests-SeedArchive at UITestLaunchArguments.swift:18,23 are checked); it is inert

Tests a removed feature: the doc's WidgetDataPublisher.publishToday, WidgetCenter.reloadAllTimelines and WidgetDataPublisherTests.swift do not exist in the repo (no Swift file references WidgetCenter; DataPurgeService.swift:647-649 states the widget target does not exist). The suite is a plain background/foreground smoke test whose name and messages claim widget coverage

units.does: Sets continueAfterFailure=false, creates XCUIApplication, appends launch arguments -UITests, -UITests-FreshInstall and English locale (UITestLanguage.english), launches the app (the app wipes onboarding/disclaimer/paywall flags, settings files and the session archive via AppLaunchRecovery.resetUITestStateIfRequested) and walks every first-run gate with UITestLaunch.toMainUI, ignoring its Bool result.
units.entry: XCTest runner: setUp before each test in the class

units.does: Releases the XCUIApplication (app = nil); does not terminate the app.
units.entry: XCTest runner: tearDown after each test in the class

units.does: Asserts the tab bar exists, presses Home, asserts SpringBoard exists, re-activates the app and asserts the tab bar exists again.

flags.text: springboard.waitForExistence is true whenever SpringBoard runs (always), so the 'Home screen must appear' assertion is tautological; the tab bar element query was resolved before backgrounding and the final check only proves the app is running
